segments.structure: section "Frequently asked questions > Is my data encrypted?"
segments.masked: Yes. Files are encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. The keys are stored in a hardware security module.

segments.structure: section "Frequently asked questions > What happens when I run out of space?"
segments.masked: Sync stops for new files. Existing files stay available, and you can free up space or upgrade at any time.
segments.original: Sync stops for new files. Existing files stay available, and you can free up space or upgrade at any time.

segments.structure: section "Frequently asked questions > Does it work offline?"
segments.masked: Files that are marked as <g1>Always keep on this device</g1> are available offline. Changes are uploaded as soon as you're back online.
